name: Competitive FPS Pack

game_settings: Frame rate limit: Unlimited or 2x monitor refresh
NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency: ON + Boost (CS2/Valorant)
os_settings: Windows Power Plan: Ultimate Performance (if available) or High Performance
Game Bar: Disabled (or configure to not interfere)
CPU Core Parking: Disabled (via registry - safe method)
driver_settings: NVIDIA Control Panel: Low Latency Mode = Ultra
NVIDIA: Power Management = Prefer Maximum Performance
Monitor: Native refresh rate + G-Sync/FreeSync OFF in competitive
background_processes: Close Discord hardware acceleration (or use performance mode)
Close RGB software (Corsair iCUE, Razer Synapse - after setting profiles)
Set game process priority to High (not Realtime)

revert_steps: Game settings: Restore to defaults in-game
Windows Power Plan: Back to Balanced
Re-enable Game Bar: Settings > Gaming > Xbox Game Bar
Re-enable full-screen optimizations: Right-click .exe > Properties > Compatibility
CPU Core Parking: Re-enable via registry or let Windows manage
GPU driver settings: Reset to default in control panel
warnings: Disabling VSync may cause screen tearing on non-adaptive sync monitors
Unlimited FPS may increase GPU heat and power draw
Some changes require game restart to take effect
Core parking changes affect all applications system-wide
notes: Optimized for competitive integrity. All changes are Vanguard/VAC-safe. Focus on reducing system latency and maximizing consistent frame delivery. Not recommended for casual play where visual quality matters.
